scope: provider-neutral AI chat model placement, fail-closed eligibility, health quarantine, and safe fallback
invariants: provider preference is never authority and cannot bypass hard constraints
turn execution budgets own routing latency cost and output ceilings
privacy is a hard eligibility constraint for primary and fallback endpoints
jurisdiction requirements fail closed when endpoint placement is unknown or disallowed
provider receipt capability is a hard constraint when requested
minimum telemetry observations and freshness are hard constraints when requested
quarantined endpoints are ineligible until explicit clear or expiry
every fallback candidate satisfies the same immutable route request
route request and route decision have deterministic sha256 evidence digests
canonical and compatibility mirror routing modules are byte-identical
model routing performs no provider network call and reads no provider credential
promotion_rule: implemented candidate only; exact-head structural, regression, and independent verification must pass before qualification
